content: Able kerkerge ge wader le tabakiauda Iesui detagerda able Pilatode wader Galilayale naresa nade wi zegulu agimuaretlare Agudim.
Ege Iesude yabi nakerda, Wa nako dikepwareda, able le wi au witle uridli pe nole mokakalam gair Galilayale uridli ableglam wi asiasi digieda able orwairorwair?
Nolekar! Ka wabi detagreda, ese wa nole wabi witlam tabatarare, wa ya gairle baum maike able orwairorwair.
A able 18 le ge baumi Siloamge nade ge able meta arapeida yabidoge abi. Wa nako dikepwareda, able eudide merbi detomerteda wige au witle urder nole mokakalam pe wader Ierusalemale uridli?
Nolekar! Ka wabi detagreda, ese wa nole wabi witlam tabatarare, wa ya gairle baum maike able orwairorwair.
Ege Iesude yabi able mir abisir mir daratagerda, “Netat lelut taba gedubge lu irti tabara ageg arwem. E bakiamuda agegem dasmerer able luge ege nole nardarda.
Ege eudige akaida tabara geduble ikaida, “Ma asor, ka pako ka tabakiamuda agegem dasmeli able luge neis a netat urut pe irdiredi, ka nole ageg nardarda. Ma abi adem ismi! E no seb detkoli.”
Ege able gedub lelut ikailu, “Kerimle, ma ko dikair netat urut; ka yaka abi darbe kemerkemer a lukup apaite.
Ese able lu ya ageg obakerare, ei debele waike; ese nolekar, ma umele ya adem ismi.”
